```{r setup}
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(dplyr)

source("web_scraper.R")

con <- dbConnect(SQLite(), "rustico_properties.sqlite")

# Prefer the parsed properties table; fall back to inline parsing from raw
n_props <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM properties")$n

if (n_props > 0) {
  props <- dbGetQuery(con, "
    SELECT p.*, r.last_seen, r.is_active, r.image_url
    FROM properties p
    JOIN raw_properties r ON r.id = p.raw_id
  ")
} else {
  raw <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM raw_properties ORDER BY page, position")
  props <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(raw)), function(i) {
    row   <- raw[i, ]
    parsed <- parse_property_text(row$raw_text)
    parsed$property_link <- row$property_link
    parsed$is_active     <- row$is_active
    parsed$last_seen     <- row$last_seen
    parsed$image_url     <- row$image_url
    parsed$image_path    <- NA_character_
    parsed
  }))
}

dbDisconnect(con)

active  <- props[!is.na(props$is_active) & props$is_active == 1, ]
n_total <- nrow(props)
n_active <- nrow(active)

prices     <- active$price_chf[!is.na(active$price_chf)]
avg_price  <- if (length(prices) > 0) round(mean(prices) / 1000) else NA
min_price  <- if (length(prices) > 0) min(prices) / 1000 else NA
max_price  <- if (length(prices) > 0) max(prices) / 1000 else NA
```

## Row {height="85%" .tabset}

### Properties

```{r}
library(DT)

tbl <- active |>
  transmute(
    Location   = paste0(postal_code, " ", city),
    Region     = region,
    Price      = ifelse(!is.na(price_chf),
                        formatC(price_chf, format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = "'"),
                        purchase_price),
    `Living m²` = living_area_m2,
    `Plot m²`   = plot_area_m2,
    Rooms       = rooms_n,
    Floors      = floors_n,
    Condition   = condition,
    Lage        = lage,
    Ausblick    = ausblick,
    Keywords    = ifelse(!is.na(interesting_keywords), interesting_keywords, ""),
    Blacklist   = ifelse(!is.na(blacklist_keywords), blacklist_keywords, ""),
    Link        = paste0('<a href="', property_link, '" target="_blank">open</a>')
  )

datatable(
  tbl,
  escape    = FALSE,
  rownames  = FALSE,
  filter    = "top",
  options   = list(
    pageLength = 25,
    order      = list(list(2, "asc")),   # sort by price ascending
    columnDefs = list(list(targets = 11, visible = FALSE))  # hide Blacklist by default
  )
) |>
  formatStyle(
    "Keywords",
    backgroundColor = styleInterval(0, c("white", "#e8f5e9")),
    target = "cell"
  ) |>
  formatStyle(
    "Blacklist",
    backgroundColor = styleInterval(0, c("white", "#ffebee")),
    target = "cell"
  )
```

### Map

```{r}
library(tmap)
library(sf)

tmap_mode("view")

# Load and filter ZIP polygons to the PLZs present in active properties
zip_all  <- st_read("data/AMTOVZ_GDB_LV95.gdb", layer = "AMTOVZ_ZIP", quiet = TRUE)
plzs     <- unique(active$postal_code[!is.na(active$postal_code)])
zip_filt <- zip_all[as.character(zip_all$ZIP4) %in% plzs, ]

# Union polygons per PLZ (some PLZs span multiple polygons), then reproject
zip_filt$postal_code <- as.character(zip_filt$ZIP4)
zip_union <- zip_filt |>
  dplyr::group_by(postal_code) |>
  dplyr::summarise(.groups = "drop") |>
  st_transform(4326)

# Per-PLZ summaries
prop_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(plzs, function(plz) {
  rows <- active[active$postal_code == plz & !is.na(active$postal_code), ]
  data.frame(
    postal_code = plz,
    city        = rows$city[1],
    n           = nrow(rows),
    prices      = paste0("CHF ", paste(
      formatC(sort(rows$price_chf, na.last = TRUE), format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = "'"),
      collapse = " / CHF "
    )),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

zip_data <- merge(zip_union, prop_summary, by = "postal_code")

tm_shape(zip_data) +
  tm_polygons(
    fill        = "n",
    fill.scale  = tm_scale_continuous(values = "brewer.blues"),
    fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Listings"),
    fill_alpha  = 0.7,
    col         = "white",
    lwd         = 1.5,
    id          = "postal_code",
    popup.vars  = c("City" = "city", "Listings" = "n", "Prices" = "prices")
  ) +
  tm_basemap("OpenStreetMap")
```
